messages:
maria-sales: Hey team — presales for FinTrust (mid-market fintech). Goals: 4-week POC, private VPC, KMS, demo LLM-based customer support routing + paraphrase-detection guardrails. Need alignment on success criteria (latency / cost / quality) and minimal setup blockers. Can we sketch targets and a quick runbook?

sam-eng: +1. Quick Qs: expected QPS and typical prompt length? also will they use streaming?

maria-sales: They expect bursty traffic up to ~150 QPS for short prompts (avg 80 tokens). Streaming not required for phase 1. Need p95 latency <=150ms for gen responses <=512 tokens and sustained availability during business hours.

raj-ml: For quality, propose an eval set: 500 seed prompts covering account inquiries, KYC FAQs, and policy paraphrase tests. Acceptance thresholds: 85% automated pass on intent classification + manual spot-check 10% with >90% human eval pass. If we use a chat-optimized 7B open model, we should quantify hallucination rate target <3% on eval set.

jess-solutions: For cost guardrail — ask for an upfront burn cap for the POC. Suggest target unit economics: <= $0.004 / 1k input+output tokens (hosted) or equivalent on Dedicated. If they commit to Dedicated we can price a small reserved pool for predictable latency.

jen-support: Security blockers: they require KMS-integrated key management, VPC-only egress, SOC2 evidence, and a short answers sheet for their vendor risk team. I can prep a trimmed security Q (top 12 Qs) and an SSO onboarding checklist.

sam-eng: Deployment plan idea: Week 0: infra and KMS + VPC peering; Week 1: model selection + baseline eval run; Week 2: integration of prompts and routing; Week 3: closed-loop eval + cost tuning; Week 4: final handoff + report. ETA depends on KMS + legal signoff.

maria-sales: That timeline works for them if infra is quick. Can we get a minimal config snippet for Dedicated to share with their infra team?

raj-ml: Putting a minimal example (low churn):
```yaml
deployment: dedicated
pool: small-reserved-1
model: rdlw-chat-7b-v1
quantization: int8
max_tokens: 512
batching: auto
kv_cache: enabled
security:
  vpc: true
  kms: customer-managed
```

sam-eng: Notes: 1) Use rdlw-chat-7b-v1 only as baseline; if they need tighter p95 we should test a 13B or a GPU with faster kernels. 2) Autoscaling policy: keep a burst buffer for business-hour spikes.

jess-solutions: For acceptance criteria doc to add to the SOW:
- Latency: p95 <= 150ms for responses <=512 tokens (measured across representative load test)
- Quality: intent classification pass >= 85% automated; human spot-check >=90% pass rate
- Cost: hosted POC average <= $0.004 / 1k tokens OR Dedicated burn within agreed monthly budget
- Security: KMS + VPC + SSO verified in security questionnaire
- Uptime: business-hours availability >=99.5% during POC window

maria-sales: Perfect. Can someone own the security Q and a short one-pager for finance (est burn calc + recommended plan)? I need those for Thursday call with customer.

jen-support: I’ll own security Qs — will drop a draft by EOD.

sam-eng: I’ll run a quick perf sweep on our test harness with the 7B and a 13B candidate, push numbers by tomorrow.

raj-ml: I’ll generate the 500-prompt eval set template and add the automatic scoring script (intent + hallucination heuristics).

infra-bot: ticket created: #POC-FT-1719998123 — assignees: jen-support, sam-eng, raj-ml. ETA: 2024-06-12.

maria-sales: Thanks all — this gives me what I need for the call. I’ll share the SOW checklist and loop in customer infra. :thumbsup:
